statement: let M0 : ℝ := Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + ∑' p : Nat.Primes, (Real.log (1 - 1 / (p.1 : ℝ)) + 1 / (p.1 : ℝ)); let E_lo : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (2.964e-6 : ℝ) / Real.log x; let E_hi : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => if x > (10 : ℝ) ^ 12 then (6.836e-6 : ℝ) / Real.log x else if Real.log x > 10 then 2 / (Real.sqrt x * Real.log x) else if Real.log x > 8.9 then (1.614e-3 : ℝ) else (1 : ℝ); (0.261497 ≤ M0 ∧ M0 ≤ 0.261498) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → Real.log (Real.log x) + M0 - E_lo x ≤ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.ceil x)).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ)) ∧ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.ceil x)).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) + M0 + E_hi x

plain_statement.en: Unconditional piecewise assembly of BuchstabSwitching.External.MertensPrimeSumPremise meisselMertensConst across [2, exp 10], (exp 10, 10¹²], and (10¹², ∞).
plain_statement.zh: 无条件三段总装 MertensPrimeSumPremise meisselMertensConst：拼接 [2, exp 10]、(exp 10, 10¹²] 与 (10¹², ∞) 三段显式 Mertens 界，直接交付 1+3 形式化所需的全部无条件素数倒数和前提。

brief.en: Pure piecewise case split on x ≤ exp 10, exp 10 < x ≤ 10¹², and 10¹² < x combining L-goldbach-mertens-small-range-cert, L-goldbach-mertens-mid-range-bjv16, and L-goldbach-mertens-tail-js32 (using Real.exp_lt_exp / Real.log_lt_log monotonicity to match `Real.log x > 10`).
brief.zh: 按 x ≤ exp 10、exp 10 < x ≤ 10¹²、10¹² < x 做纯分情况拼接，依次调用 L-goldbach-mertens-small-range-cert、L-goldbach-mertens-mid-range-bjv16 与 L-goldbach-mertens-tail-js32 即可直接总装。
